About this item

  • 【 Clean 6X More Plaque】For a clean that wow –removing up to 600% more teeth stain than a regular manual toothbrush. TEETHEORY rotating electric toothbrush goes above and beyond by effectively cleans more teeth stain compared to a regular toothbrush. This exceptional performance is attributed to its robust motor, innovative windmill design, and precision-crafted arc-cut bristles
  • 【Professional Dual Clean Replacement Toothbrush Heads】The Dual Clean replacement toothbrush head has 2 type brush heads for a comprehensive clean. One bristle with special soft glue section cleans exogenous coloration effectively to whiten teeth, while the other head with 60% greater density durable bristles provides deep cleaning and 𝟏𝟎𝟎% teeth stain removing. Dual Action provides superior cleaning
  • 【8 Replacement Brush Heads Last for 2 Years 】TEETHEORY rotating electric toothbrush comes with 8 DuPont brush heads, which you can use for 2 years. You can share a toothbrush, and different color collars can be used to distinguish the toothbrush heads of different family members. You will know it's time to change the brush head
  • 【4 Modes for Various Oral Care Needs】4 high-performance modes are designed to meet all your oral care needs and help maintain a healthy mouth. Whitening, Cleaning, Sensitive, Polishing, Massage. Whitening mode 100% teeth stain removing and tartar dislodging on teeth. Clean mode goes deep into the inter dental, cleans the dirt hidden in the periodontal. While massage mode offers a gentle massage of gums
  • 【25-Day Battery Life】TEETHEORY electric toothbrush features a 4-hour quick charge battery that lasts up to 25 days, far outperforming other toothbrushes on the market. you can always use this toothbrush while traveling or on a business trip
